title: The component diagram of a geometric generic fiber
statement:
Let $X$ be a nonempty irreducible affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-irreducible-components]. Let $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point over its generic point, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $U\to X$ be an affine ind-etale morphism [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] with $U$ w-contractible [sk-def-pe-wlocal]. Put $V=U\times_X\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, $S=\pi_0(U)$ and $S_\eta=\pi_0(V)$, all component spaces carrying the quotient topology [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. The induced continuous map $r:S_\eta\to S$ is surjective and has a continuous section $s:S\to S_\eta$ with $r\circ s=\operatorname{id}_S$.

The canonical component maps of sites give a commutative square
$$\begin{array}{ccc} V_{\mathrm{proet}}&\xrightarrow{\pi_V}&(S_\eta)_{\mathrm{proet}}\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow r\\ U_{\mathrm{proet}}&\xrightarrow{\pi_U}& S_{\mathrm{proet}} .\end{array}$$
Here $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $(S_\eta)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ mean profinite sets over these spaces with finite jointly surjective covering families. The map $\pi_V$ is an equivalence of sheaf topoi, compatible with pullback of every condensed coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Consequently it gives an equivalence of their module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and carries scalar extensions of constant discrete complexes to the corresponding scalar extensions. The map $V\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ corresponds under this equivalence to the map $S_\eta\to *$.
